SIO.scope: ShellOneCommand entry to final RTL; includes parsing, redirection, LIST load/launch/wait/cleanup; excludes typing and prompt. DOSCALLS implementations cover resident and loaded callers. Routine spans include preemption and overlap. First-row bitmap completion is the last synchronous text return before the row-ending Write returns, including newline/caret painting; this bounds fenced VRAM visibility, not monitor scanout.
SIO.cache_scope: Cold: all read-cache tags, scratch sector and SDFS map/directory/extent identities invalidated at idle prompt; mounts and current-directory lock remain admitted. Warm: exact command repeated after CLS; no filesystem changes.
SIO.input: Prefilled empty cooked-line buffer, physical Return, ordinary cooked Drain and shell dispatch; typing excluded from timing
